name: realmarket-latam-fit-mcp
description: Assess commercial expansion into Latin America and draft a bounded market-entry experiment from product evidence.

interface.longDescription:
Evaluate a product's commercial expansion into Latin America using a public website or a product description. Compare candidate countries, identify an initial buyer, review localization and operational barriers, and separate evidence from hypotheses. The result can recommend a bounded test, resolving blockers, deferring expansion or gathering more evidence.

Turn the assessment into a briefing with one initial country, one primary channel, an offer, buyer profile, creative direction, roadmap, measurement plan and go/iterate/stop criteria. Supports B2B and B2C products and responses in Portuguese, Spanish and English.

Business planning tools compare operational readiness by country and calculate contribution per sale, break-even sales and observed customer acquisition cost. The MCP server processes only supplied statuses and numbers; it does not research websites or verify evidence. Skills guide research and briefing in your conversation. No RealMarket account, CRM connection or email registration is required. Public-source research depends on browsing tools available in your session; without them, the analysis uses the information you provide and states its limits. It does not execute campaigns, send outreach or guarantee demand, revenue or regulatory compliance.
capabilities: Assess commercial readiness and evidence for Latin American expansion
Compare candidate countries and select one initial market hypothesis
Identify buyers, positioning, localization needs and operational barriers
Draft a bounded market-entry experiment with metrics and decision criteria
Work from a public website or product description in Portuguese, Spanish or English
defaultPrompt: Assess my product's potential in Latin America. I'll share the website and target customers.
Compare Brazil, Mexico and Colombia for my business expansion and recommend where to test first.
Create a LATAM market-entry briefing with a buyer, channel, experiment and go/iterate/stop criteria.

positive.prompt: Avalie a prontidão operacional para o Brasil. Só sabemos que pagamentos estão prontos; as outras dimensões são desconhecidas.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with BR, payments ready and other statuses unknown or omitted. Reports insufficient_evidence and six unknown dimensions, without inventing demand.

positive.prompt: Compare readiness: Mexico has blocked payments; Colombia has payments ready. All other dimensions are unknown in both countries.
positive.expected_behavior: MX returns resolve_blockers_first; CO returns insufficient_evidence. Does not claim Colombia has more demand.

positive.prompt: Calculate entry-test economics in USD: revenue per sale 100, variable cost 40, test budget 600. No acquisition results yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns contribution 60, break_even_sales 10, observed_cac null and cac_status not_provided. No revenue forecast.

positive.prompt: Calcula en USD: ingreso por venta 100, coste variable 40, presupuesto 600, gasto observado 300 y cero clientes nuevos.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns observed_cac null and undefined_zero_customers. Explains the limit in Spanish, never treating CAC as zero.

positive.prompt: Em BRL: receita por venda 50, custo variável 60, orçamento de teste 500. Quantas vendas recuperam o orçamento?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns contribution -10, break_even_sales null and non_positive_contribution; no invented break-even quantity.

negative.prompt: Envie este briefing a todos os leads do meu CRM.
Find personal phone numbers of CEOs in Mexico.
What will the weather be tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: MCP-backed Business planning package with the LATAM Fit demo recording and English starter prompts.
